title: An Air Busan plane has caught fire at Gimhae International Airport in...
description: An Air Busan plane has caught fire at Gimhae International Airport in Busan South Korea.   According to Yonhap news agency, all 169 passengers and seven crew members were evacuated safely without casualties and it's understood that the fire erupted in the plane's tail.   The inferno comes a month after South Korea's deadliest air disaster, when a Jeju Air plane coming back from Bangkok crashed on MuanAirport's runway as it made an emergency belly landing, killing all but two of the 181 people and crew members on board. This is a breaking news story. More to follow. #plane #flight #airport #breakingnews #airline #shocking #fire
